system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Custom instructions are natural language descriptions saved in Markdown files in the repository. They are automatically included in prompts you enter while working in that repository.
system_prompt_style.evidence_locator: paper Using Copilot CLI / Use custom instructions
system_prompt_style.note: Instructions files, AGENTS.md, skills and agent profiles composed into context at runtime.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Copilot may attempt to read, modify, and execute files in and below this folder.
env_context_strategy.note: User can also inject files with @path; custom instructions auto-included.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: GitHub Copilot CLI automatically starts compressing your history in the background when your conversation approaches 80% of the token limit.

observation_format.evidence_quote: You can attach images and PDFs to your prompts when using a model that supports image input.
observation_format.note: Images are user-attached inputs; tool output text otherwise.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Copilot CLI comes with the GitHub MCP server already configured.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not documented.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Copilot CLI comes with the GitHub MCP server already configured. This MCP server allows you to interact with resources on GitHub.com
protocol_standardization.note: 'other' = Copilot CLI ACP server listed under Further reading.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Plan mode lets you collaborate with Copilot on an implementation plan before any code is written.
loop_primitives.note: Plan mode is opt-in via Shift+Tab; default is the tool-use loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plan mode lets you collaborate with Copilot on an implementation plan before any code is written. Press Shift+Tab to cycle in and out of plan mode.
planning_granularity.note: No stored plan object documented; plan mode is opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The AI model being used by the CLI can choose to delegate a task to a subsidiary subagent process, that operates using a custom agent with specific expertise
multi_agent_topology.note: Default group of custom agents ships enabled.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: can choose to delegate a task to a subsidiary subagent process, that operates using a custom agent with specific expertise, if it judges that this would result in the work being completed more effectively

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When Copilot wants to use a tool that could modify or execute files—for example, touch, chmod, node, or sed—it will ask you to approve the use of the tool.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: You can create skills to enhance the ability of Copilot to perform specialized tasks with instructions, scripts, and resources.
long_term_memory.note: file_notes from persistent custom instructions/AGENTS.md re-injected each run.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: You can use the --resume command-line option or the /resume slash command to select and resume an interactive CLI session, allowing you to pick up right where you left off, with the saved context.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Rubber duck Acts as a constructive critic to provide feedback on some non-trivial tasks. Used automatically by Copilot CLI.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Instead, it ends the current operation and awaits your next prompt.
termination_condition.note: Interactive loop returns to the user when the model stops; no step/cost caps documented.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The amount of GitHub AI Credits used in the current session
cost_controls.note: Usage tracked via /usage; explicit budget enforcement not documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Local sandboxing does not run the CLI itself in a sandbox; instead, the commands and tools that Copilot CLI runs on your behalf are restricted
execution_isolation.note: Default runs commands locally; /sandbox enable and copilot --cloud give sandbox/remote options.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: If a prompt you have entered in an interactive session requires Copilot to modify a file outside the current location, it will ask you to approve access to the file's directory.
filesystem_access.evidence_locator: paper Work with files in a different location
filesystem_access.note: Scoped to trusted directories; expandable with /add-dir.

network_policy.evidence_quote: limiting their access to your filesystem, network, and system capabilities. To enable local sandboxing, enter /sandbox enable inside a session.
network_policy.note: Network restriction only under opt-in sandboxing; default unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: it will ask you to approve the use of the tool.
permission_model.note: Session-wide approvals and copilot help permissions allowlists also exist.

replayability.evidence_quote: resume an interactive CLI session, allowing you to pick up right where you left off, with the saved context
